subject: New Manager Onboarding: Performance Management & Difficult Conversations Playbook
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Manager onboarding playbook (perf mgmt + coaching)

Hi all,

Attached is a first draft of the New Manager Playbook focused on performance management and running difficult conversations. The intention: a short modular program for managers in their first 90 days that covers goal-setting, real-time feedback, mid-cycle calibration, and coaching for high-stakes conversations.

Highlights in this draft:
- 90-min core workshop (confidential handling of PII + HR escalation flow)
- Optional 30-min 1:1 coaching slots (role-play)
- Scripts for corrective conversations and performance improvement plan templates
- Guidance for recording sensitive notes and when to escalate to HR/legal

Please review and let me know:
1) Any regulatory/legal flags we should add given customer data exposure (esp. for private deployment teams)
2) Whether we should bring an external facilitator for the role-play sessions
3) Proposed dates in week of March 23 (works for me)

Attached: new-manager-playbook-v1.pdf (draft)

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: new-manager-playbook-v1.pdf (1.2 MB)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Manager onboarding playbook (perf mgmt + coaching)

Laura — thanks for the draft, this looks excellent and practical. A few immediate asks:

- Attendance: can we prioritize new managers hired in the last 6 months, plus any senior ICs being promoted in Q2? I'd like a roll-up list.
- Sensitive topics: can we include a short checklist for managers on what belongs in manager notes vs PII and how to store recorded role-play artifacts? If Legal needs to sign off, loop them early.
- External facilitator: I support bringing someone experienced for the role-play sessions — the team needs real coaching on tone and escalation language. Can you ping a few vendors?

Kirk McCoy at PeopleFirst ran a tough-conversations workshop I found helpful — I'll introduce him if Kirk's available. Also: can we add a 45-min follow-up clinic two weeks after the workshop for concrete case reviews (no recordings)?

I'll take point on confirming attendees from the engineering managers list.

Cheers,
Tessa
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 14:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Draft: Manager onboarding playbook (perf mgmt + coaching)

Thanks for the note and for sharing the draft — I appreciate the emphasis on practical scripts. I can run the proposed 90-minute workshop and offer two formats:

1) 90-min interactive cohort workshop (up to 20 managers) — includes live role-play in small groups.
2) Three 60-min clinics (follow-up) + up to six 1:1 coaching slots (30 min each) the following two weeks.

Logistics and price: standard fee for the 90-min workshop + 3 clinics is $6,500. 1:1 coaching is an add-on at $200 per slot. I can offer the workshop week of March 23 — Thurs March 26 is open right now.

I will not record role-plays unless you request it; I recommend redacting any PII and keeping case notes in HR's secure folder. Sample deck attached.

Booking link: https://calendly.com/peoplefirst/kirk-90min-workshop
Deck: difficult-conversations-guide.pptx

Best,
Kirk McCoy
Founder, PeopleFirst Consulting

[Attachment: difficult-conversations-guide.pptx (4.7 MB)]

Subject: Final schedule proposal & attendee list (manager cohort 1)

Hi team — per our sync:

Proposed core session
- Date: Thurs, 26 Mar 2026
- Time: 10:00–11:30 PT (90 min)
- Format: Zoom (no recording by default), breakout rooms for role-play

Follow-ups
- Three clinics: Mon 30 Mar, Wed 01 Apr, Fri 03 Apr (45 min each)
- 1:1 slots: Apr 6–10 (sign-up grid in the Drive)

Attendee cohort (draft attached): 18 managers — prioritized by hire/promote date. Please review and flag any sensitive cases that should be pre-screened by HR before the clinic.

Privacy notes / legal: I flagged a policy question on recording and storage. Legal prefers no recordings of role-play that include employee scenarios with PII. We can keep redacted redlines in the HR folder and require manager attestation that any case shared is anonymized.

Attachments: attendee-list-mgrs.csv

Next steps:
- Laura: confirm external vendor/contracting route or we can use internal facilitators if needed.
- Tessa & Vivek: confirm any managers you want to exclude (sensitive ongoing investigations).
- I'll open a Google Drive folder with the final materials and sign-up grid.

Thanks,
Stephanie

Thanks — schedule looks good and I appreciate the privacy guardrails. Quick notes from my side:

- I reviewed the attendee list and flagged two managers (rows 7 and 12) who are currently involved in separate performance investigations; per policy those two should be excluded from the cohort until matters close. I'll send a separate note with case IDs to HR (confidential).
- I'd like to lead one of the breakout rooms for a case study on calibration conversations — happy to draft a 10-min scenario aligned to Redwood's performance rubric.
- For materials: could we add a one-page cheat sheet for the first 7 days after a difficult conversation (do's/don'ts + escalation contacts)? That would be really helpful for new managers.

If we agree on exclusions and add the cheat sheet, I'm good to confirm with my managers.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
